audit.whatIsWrong: Chart gave Skill at Levels 4-5 and 6 and Gwen at 2+ items, while the prose calls 6 'your hardest clean kill window' and says outright 'full-AP Vlad out-scales you'.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Skill/Gwen/Gwen/Gwen/Gwen/Gwen/Vladimir, matching a 54.63% win rate that comes from lane dominance, not scaling.
audit.corrected: Chart realigned in both layers; difficulty 6/10 lowered to 5/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: Phase rows were template text, and the page repeats '~28s cooldown' for Sanguine Pool as if it were fixed.
audit.why: Sanguine Pool is 28/25/22/19/16s — by rank 5 it is 16 seconds, which is why the kill window narrows as the lane goes on.
audit.corrected: The rank curve written into the First item row and the cooldown block.

audit.whatIsWrong: The late-game section says 'Vlad doesn't stack HP — so you lose your signature anti-tank edge against him specifically'. That is backwards. Two other interactions are also missing.
audit.why: Riot on Crimson Pact: 'every 1 point of Ability Power gives Vladimir 1.6 bonus Health' — a full-AP Vladimir therefore carries a large health pool, which is exactly what %-max-HP Snip Snip! and A Thousand Cuts punish. What actually beats Gwen here is his healing, not his tankiness, so Grievous Wounds is the answer rather than despair. Riot on Tides of Blood: it 'can be blocked by enemy units', so standing behind your own minions denies his poke outright. Riot on Hemoplague: 'Affected enemies take increased damage' and it 'heals Vladimir for each enemy Champion hit', so it is a damage amplifier and a scaling heal, not a nuke.
audit.corrected: Crimson Pact corrected, minion-block on Tides of Blood added, Hemoplague described accurately.

audit.why: Sanguine Pool 28/25/22/19/16s for 2 seconds of untargetability; Tides of Blood 13/11/9/7/5s and it costs him health to charge; Transfusion 9 down to 4.6s.
audit.corrected: Written into the cooldown block, trading rules and dos.

edits.before: Good trade: Stack passive on minions, E onto Vladimir with the center-Q ready, snip the %HP true damage, and W if he turns. Great trade: Vladimir wastes Sanguine Pool — commit the full pattern immediately. Bad trade: Dropping W early or fighting outside it against his key tool — the mist IS the matchup for ranged answers.

edits.before: W-mist his pool window — build MR, anti-heal, Snip his HP. Gwen wins by trading around Vladimir's Sanguine Pool and cashing the pattern: build MR, anti-heal, and Snip his HP.

edits.before: Here's the honest part: full-AP Vlad out-scales you. Once he has Rylai's and Liandry's he kites you with the slow, pools your Needlework to dodge it cleanly, and his ult-amplified Tides of Blood plus Transfusion drain heal him through your DPS faster than you can grind him down. Your %-max-HP Q still bites, but Vlad doesn't stack HP — so you lose your signature anti-tank edge against him specifically. Win lane hard from 6 to your first item, take towers, and shove the game toward your team before his scaling reduces you to a sidelane that can't close him out.
edits.after: Here's the honest part: full-AP Vlad out-scales you. Once he has Rylai's and Liandry's he kites you with the slow, pools your Needlework to dodge it cleanly, and his ult-amplified Tides of Blood plus Transfusion drain heal him through your DPS faster than you can grind him down. Your %-max-HP Q still bites, because Crimson Pact converts every point of his AP into 1.6 bonus health — it is his healing, not his tankiness, that beats you, so anti-heal is mandatory. Win lane hard from 6 to your first item, take towers, and shove the game toward your team before he closes you out.

edits.before: Stack Transfusion sustain and Tides of Blood poke to whittle you down from range before you reach mist trades
edits.after: Charge Tides of Blood where no minion blocks it and stack Transfusion to whittle you before you reach mist trades

notes: The page told the player Vladimir does not stack HP and that Gwen therefore loses her anti-tank edge — Crimson Pact converts 1 AP into 1.6 bonus health, so the opposite is true and the real problem is his healing, which points at Grievous Wounds. Tides of Blood being blocked by enemy units (stand behind your minions) was also missing, and Sanguine Pool's 28-to-16 second rank curve was quoted as a flat 28.
